Localization.Name: C1 Spirit 2954 Ship Showdown Poster
Localization.Description: With enough versatility to tackle multiple roles and unpredictable jobs, it's easy to understand why Crusader's C1 Spirit was part of the 2954 Ship Showdown's Final Four. A multi-purpose starship tuned for mid-range cargo delivery and courier work, this poster celebrates the C1 Spirit and Crusader Industries' commitment to excellence.
